messages:
hema: Heads-up: I'm drafting a compact "Public Readiness" rubric for multi-tier inference GA. Need fast alignment from Docs, SRE, Billing, and Support by EOD.

lucas: OK. What are the top lanes you want covered?

hema: Five lanes: regression & safety gate, latency SLOs + fallback, telemetry & alerts, customer docs/runbooks, billing/quota policy. One owner per lane, pass/fail checks.

nora: I'll own docs/runbooks. Deliverables: one-page launch card, migration pointers for Dedicated/Private, minimal rollback steps, customer-facing retry guidance, escalation contact table.

samir: Billing: define free-tier caps, committed vs burst pricing, preview credits, and precise wording for KV-cache billing. Also a throttle message payload for SDKs.

lucas: SLOs suggestion: p95 <= 350ms (standard), p95 <= 700ms (long context). Service error rate < 0.35% (5xx+timeouts). Fallback rule: sustained p95 > 2x for 15m -> auto-route to compatible variant.

ops-bot: Reminder: auto-route requires a documented circuit-breaker and a tested rollback play (owner: eng-runtime).

hema: Telemetry needs: per-model token counts, cost-per-token burn chart, and request-id -> trace join. Alerts: SLO burn >50% over 5m or error spike >0.5% in 1m.

nora: I'll publish the Launch Card + SDK retry snippet by EOD and link to the checklist doc.

samir: Ops constraint: free-tier QPS = max 10 qps/account with explicit throttle message + billing link. Dedicated trials must include an overage clause and contact for quota increases.

lucas: Support plan: Tier-1 playbook in CS plus a staffed 72-hour critical rota post-deploy. Owners: eng-platform + eng-sre.

hema: Proposed gate to flip from beta -> GA: (1) checklists green, (2) regression smoke pass (3k prompts across critical intents), (3) load test at 2x expected traffic for 30m meeting p95 targets, (4) pricing page + billing link live, (5) 72-hour rota staffed.

lucas: Non-negotiable: automated fallback and rollback automation must be exercised end-to-end; no manual-only emergency path.

nora: Docs non-negotiable: short runbook with explicit escalation matrix and primary/secondary contacts.

samir: Billing non-negotiable: explicit Dedicated trial overage policy signed off by finance.

hema: Timeline: if Docs + Billing OK today, eng-runtime will wire fallback by Wed, infra dashboards Thu, load test Fri. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for go/no-go.

ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled 2025-05-28 02:00 UTC — confirm rota if go.

nora: Ack, I'll be oncall first 8 hours.

samir: I'll update pricing page and loop in finance by 3pm.

hema: Thanks all  I'll post the one-page rubric to the tracker and tag owners. Closing thread.
